project_info.theme: Toyota Yaris Cross multi-style personality collage
project_info.color_palette: White, blue, yellow, red, warm beige, black

main_subject.detail: A dynamic collage poster featuring multiple stylish young adults and Toyota Yaris Cross vehicles. The central headline reads 'YARIS CROSS NGHE DA CHIEU CHIEU DA KIEU'. Four collage panels show different personalities: a short-haired person in sunglasses on the phone beside the phrase 'LINH HOAT NHU CAU LAM BOSS CHUAN NGAU'; a woman in a red outfit standing by a red Yaris Cross with the phrase 'LINH HOAT CA TINH LAM "EM XINH XAN"'; a smiling man in blue posing beside a blue Yaris Cross with the phrase 'LINH HOAT TRAI NGHIEM LAM BAN NHIET HUYET'; and a man holding a Toyota key fob toward the camera with the phrase 'LINH HOAT TIEN ICH LAM "CHANG" BAN LINH'. Toyota logo is top left and 'Move your world' appears bottom left.
main_subject.style: Editorial lifestyle collage with bold youth-fashion photography, cutout panel layout, and energetic urban-brand storytelling

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / YARIS CROSS / NGHE DA CHIEU / CHIEU DA KIEU / LINH HOAT NHU CAU LAM BOSS CHUAN NGAU / LINH HOAT CA TINH LAM "EM XINH XAN" / LINH HOAT TRAI NGHIEM LAM BAN NHIET HUYET / LINH HOAT TIEN ICH LAM "CHANG" BAN LINH / Move your world

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Yaris Cross multi-style personality collage. Centerpiece is a four-panel lifestyle composition mixing fashionable young adults, a red Yaris Cross, a blue Yaris Cross, and a close-up Toyota key fob. Background is a clean white collage field with blue and yellow panel blocks. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact title 'YARIS CROSS NGHE DA CHIEU CHIEU DA KIEU', the four personality caption cards 'LINH HOAT NHU CAU LAM BOSS CHUAN NGAU', 'LINH HOAT CA TINH LAM "EM XINH XAN"', 'LINH HOAT TRAI NGHIEM LAM BAN NHIET HUYET', and 'LINH HOAT TIEN ICH LAM "CHANG" BAN LINH', plus the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photo-collage advertising poster with editorial fashion and automotive compositing, bright editorial-commercial lighting, crisp cutout shadows and glossy car highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
